places.name: Machu Picchu Citadel
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, offering breathtaking views and rich history.

opening_hours.notes: Tickets must be purchased in advance.

places.place_tip: Book tickets early and consider hiring a guide.

attribution.title: Peru Machu Picchu Sunrise
attribution.author: Allard Schmidt (The Netherlands)
attribution.description: Allard Schmidt: "This picture was taken at sunrise, after hiking ahead of the group towards Machu Picchu I found Machu Picchu empty, Wayne Pichu was covered in clouds. After waiting 10 minutes the clouds dissolved beautifully resulting in this picture. Unfortunately, the moment the thin clouds covered Wayne Pichu was very short, there was no time to change the camera light exposure settings in order to correct the overexposure."

places.name: Huayna Picchu
places.ai_summary: A steep mountain adjacent to Machu Picchu, offering panoramic views of the citadel and surrounding landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Limited tickets available daily.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes and be prepared for steep climbs.

places.name: Sun Gate (Inti Punku)
places.ai_summary: The Sun Gate, or Inti Punku, is the traditional entrance to Machu Picchu, offering stunning sunrise views over the citadel.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good viewing spot.

places.name: Temple of the Sun
places.ai_summary: An ancient Inca temple in Machu Picchu, dedicated to the Sun God, featuring a semicircular wall and a large stone altar.

opening_hours.notes: Part of the Machu Picchu complex.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Intihuatana Stone.

places.name: Temple of the Three Windows
places.ai_summary: An archaeological site in Machu Picchu, featuring three large windows that frame the Andes mountains, believed to have astronomical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Part of the Machu Picchu complex.

places.place_tip: Look for the Inca cross symbol near the windows.

places.name: Sacred Plaza
places.ai_summary: The main square of Machu Picchu, surrounded by important religious and political buildings, including the Temple of the Sun and the Intihuatana Stone.

opening_hours.notes: Part of the Machu Picchu complex.

places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding buildings and terraces.

places.name: Temple of the Condor
places.ai_summary: An Inca temple in Machu Picchu, designed in the shape of a condor, with outstretched wings formed by large stone slabs.

opening_hours.notes: Part of the Machu Picchu complex.

places.place_tip: Observe the rock formations resembling a condor's head and wings.

places.name: Inca Bridge Trail
places.ai_summary: A short but scenic trail in Machu Picchu, leading to an Inca bridge built into the cliffside, offering stunning views of the valley.

opening_hours.notes: Bring water and snacks, as facilities are limited.

places.place_tip: The trail can be steep and narrow in sections.

attribution.title: 106 - Machu Picchu - Juin 2009
attribution.author: Martin St-Amant (S23678)
attribution.description: The Inca Bridge, near Machu Picchu

places.name: Intihuatana Stone
places.ai_summary: A ritual stone associated with astronomy and agriculture, carved by the Incas, located at the highest point of Machu Picchu.

opening_hours.notes: Part of the Machu Picchu complex.

places.place_tip: Do not climb on the stone; it's a sacred object.

places.name: Agricultural Terraces
places.ai_summary: Terraces built by the Incas for agriculture, demonstrating advanced farming techniques and offering stunning views of the Urubamba River valley.

opening_hours.notes: Part of the Machu Picchu complex.

places.place_tip: Observe the different levels of terraces and their irrigation systems.

places.name: Inca Trail to Machu Picchu (4-Day Trek)
places.ai_summary: A famous trekking route leading to Machu Picchu, passing through diverse ecosystems, Inca ruins, and offering breathtaking mountain views.
places.name_english: Inca Trail to Machu Picchu (4-Day Trek)

opening_hours.notes: Trek permits must be booked in advance.

places.place_tip: Acclimatize to the altitude before the trek.

places.name: Hydroelectric Route Trail
places.ai_summary: An alternative route to Machu Picchu, following the railway tracks from Hydroelectric Station, offering scenic views of the Urubamba River and lush vegetation.

opening_hours.notes: Bring water and snacks, as facilities are limited.

places.place_tip: Be cautious of passing trains on the railway tracks.

attribution.title: Apache Junction-Historic Apache Trail
attribution.author: Marine 69-71
attribution.description: Historic Apache Trail sign on Highway 88.

places.name: Aguas Calientes Hot Springs
places.ai_summary: Natural hot springs located in Aguas Calientes, the gateway town to Machu Picchu, offering a relaxing experience after exploring the ruins.

opening_hours.notes: Bring your own towel and swimsuit.

places.place_tip: Book a private room for a more relaxing experience.

attribution.title: Aguas Calientes, Cuzco, Perú, 2015-07-30, DD 68
attribution.author: Diego Delso
attribution.description: Pachacútec statue, Aguas Calientes, Cuzco, Peru

places.name: Machu Picchu Museum (Aguas Calientes)
places.ai_summary: A museum located in Aguas Calientes, showcasing the history, culture, and archaeological findings of the Machu Picchu area.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Sundays in February.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Butterfly House.

places.name: Mandor Gardens
places.ai_summary: Beautifully landscaped gardens located near Aguas Calientes, featuring a variety of native plants, flowers, and scenic walking paths.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 4:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Bring water and wear comfortable shoes.
places.address: Mandor, Aguas Calientes, Machu Picchu, Peru

attribution.title: Ashram Express board
attribution.author: Ravi Dwivedi
attribution.description: Ashram Express runs between Delhi and Ahmedabad.

places.name: Butterfly House (Aguas Calientes)
places.ai_summary: A conservation center and exhibition space in Aguas Calientes, dedicated to the preservation and display of native butterfly species.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Sundays in February.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Machu Picchu Museum.

places.name: Local Handicraft Market
places.ai_summary: A vibrant market in Aguas Calientes, offering a variety of handmade crafts, souvenirs, and local products.

opening_hours.notes: Bargaining is common and encouraged.

places.place_tip: Look for unique souvenirs and handicrafts.

places.name: Putucusi Mountain Trail
places.ai_summary: A challenging hike near Machu Picchu, leading to the summit of Putucusi Mountain, offering panoramic views of the Inca citadel and surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Not recommended for those with fear of heights.

places.place_tip: The trail is steep and requires careful navigation.

places.name: Morning Sunrise at Machu Picchu
places.ai_summary: Experiencing the sunrise at Machu Picchu is a magical and spiritual moment, as the first rays of sun illuminate the ancient Inca citadel.

opening_hours.notes: Arrive early to secure a good spot.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and be prepared for crowds.

places.name: Panoramic Viewing Platforms
places.ai_summary: Designated areas in Machu Picchu offering panoramic views of the citadel, mountains, and the Urubamba River valley.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Respect the designated viewing areas and trails.
